STRONG_BUY.condition: Use only the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K package. Set veto V if it is expressly preliminary or has unresolved corrected/conflicting figures; Q2 total Gross Bookings is missing; both issuer-defined non-GAAP EPS and Adjusted EBITDA are missing; a material Q2 definition/scope/inorganic change lacks a like-for-like bridge and could cross a cutoff; or guidance is explicitly withdrawn/suspended because of material uncertainty. Score Q2 Gross Bookings b: +2 at ≥$58.60B, +1 at $58.00–<58.60B, -1 at >$55.40–≤56.00B, -2 at ≤$55.40B, otherwise 0. Score Q2 constant-currency Gross Bookings growth c from an unrounded rate: +2 at ≥23.5%, +1 at >22.0–<23.5%, -1 at >16.5–<18.0%, -2 at ≤16.5%, otherwise 0; if only a whole percentage is supplied, use +2 at ≥24%, +1 at 23%, -1 at 17%, -2 at ≤16%, otherwise 0. Score non-GAAP EPS n: +2 at ≥$0.87, +1 at $0.84–<0.87, -1 at >$0.72–≤0.76, -2 at ≤$0.72, otherwise 0. Score EBITDA e: +2 at ≥$2.87B, +1 at $2.83–<2.87B, -1 at >$2.63–≤2.67B, -2 at ≤$2.63B, otherwise 0. Score Q3 constant-currency bookings midpoint q: +2 at ≥21.5%, +1 at 20.0–<21.5%, -1 at >16.5–<18.0%, -2 at ≤16.5%, otherwise 0. Score Q3 EBITDA growth r versus $2.256B: +2 at ≥38%, +1 at 32–<38%, -1 at >22–≤27%, -2 at ≤22%, otherwise 0. A missing or noncomparable secondary input is 0. Combine each pair into D=combine(b,c), P=combine(n,e), O=combine(q,r): opposite nonzero signs set V; same-sign nonzero inputs return that sign times the smaller magnitude; exactly one nonzero input returns its sign with magnitude 1; neither returns 0. Also set V if present, same-definition non-GAAP operating income materially contradicts P: P>0 with YoY growth ≤0 and margin down ≥20bp, or P<0 with growth ≥30% and margin up ≥20bp. If any of D/P/O is positive and another negative, set V. Corporate overlay X versus €41.50/share, ~$14.8B equity value/~€14B bridge, <2x leverage, accretive-at-close/high-single-digit year-three accretion and H2 2027 close is +1/-1 for a uniquely favorable/adverse change of ≥5% in consideration/required financing, ≥0.25x leverage, ≥3 percentage points year-three accretion, ≥1 year accretion timing, a new ≥$1B value/cash effect, or ≥2% share reduction/dilution; use ±2 at twice a listed threshold. Mixed, conditional, unquantified-material, termination, or timing-only changes without a unique economic sign set V; otherwise X=0. Let A=D+P+O; X opposing A, or nonzero X with A=0, sets V; otherwise F=A+X. STRONG_BUY applies exactly when V is false, D=+2, P=+2, and O≥+1.
